test_tool_hash_scope: Isolation fixture hashes are checked against its execution report. The host runner records firmware fingerprint and logs but no execution-time fixture hashes; current_test_tool_sha256 records the exporter-time file snapshot.
limitations: No physical board, power-circuit dynamics, real ADC/FO/FB signal or hardware fault-path validation.
Host integration replaces only hardware boundaries; the virtual current is an independent waveform and does not respond to PWM or PI outputs.
Macro-off lexical and normalized TI ISR assembly comparisons establish the checked source/instruction equivalence, not full executable byte identity or measured 100 us latency.
Macro-on adds waveform calculation to the 10 kHz path; physical interrupt duration and missed-interrupt measurements remain outstanding.
This export validates existing reports and current hashes; it does not rebuild firmware or rerun behavioral test suites.
Delivery identity uses the release tag and firmware input fingerprint, avoiding a self-referential final commit hash. The tag can be applied after the summary is committed.
